FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #8 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is enchantée said? (1 mark)
   A. en-chan-TEE
   B. ench-ant-EE
   C. en-kan-TAY
   D. on-shon-TAY

2. What does 'Ça va bien, merci.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye, Sir.
   B. I am well, thank you.
   C. Yes, I am fine.
   D. And you?

3. What does 'C'est ma mère.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My brother is called Kamau.
   B. It is the baby.
   C. This is my mother.
   D. Who is it?

4. Which accent is on the é in bébé? (1 mark)
   A. accent grave
   B. circonflexe
   C. cédille
   D. accent aigu

5. What does 'Voici mon grand-père.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Here is my grandmother.
   B. Here is my grandfather.
   C. My sister is called Njeri.
   D. This is my sister.

6. Which little word goes with 'sac' (the bag)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. l'
   C. la
   D. les

7. Read: Voici ma maison. Dans la cuisine, il y a une table et deux chaises. Le frigo est près de la porte. Mon lit est sous la fenêtre. Question: How many chairs are in the kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. one
   B. two
   C. four
   D. three

8. Fill in: Aujourd'hui, c'est mercredi. Demain, c'est ______. (1 mark)
   A. jeudi
   B. mardi
   C. dimanche
   D. lundi

9. What does 'Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today it is Monday.
   B. On Thursday, I sing.
   C. What day is it today?
   D. On Sunday, I rest.

10. What does 'Mon anniversaire, c'est le 30 juin.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I sing and I dance.
   B. My birthday is on 30 June.
   C. Happy birthday!
   D. There is a cake and there are balloons.

11. Which number is trente et un? (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 21
   C. 13
   D. 31

12. What does 'C'est un gâteau.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I do not like fish.
   B. At midday, I eat rice and beans.
   C. I like milk.
   D. It is a cake.

13. Which little word goes with 'jus' (the juice)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. la
   D. l'

14. Fill in: Elle est ______. (short) (1 mark)
   A. longs
   B. petite
   C. noirs
   D. petit

15. Which little word goes with 'doigt' (the finger)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. le
   C. les
   D. la

16. What does 'Il a les cheveux courts.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have ten fingers.
   B. I have a mouth.
   C. He has short hair.
   D. I have two hands.

17. What does 'Il y a du vent.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. There is a storm.
   B. It is cloudy.
   C. It is sunny.
   D. It is windy.

18. What does 'Aujourd'hui, il pleut.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today it is raining.
   B. Tomorrow the weather is nice.
   C. It is snowing.
   D. I stay in the house.

19. What does 'La porte est à côté de la fenêtre.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   B. The door is next to the window.
   C. Where is the key?
   D. Excuse me, where is the school?

20. What does 'Allez tout droit.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   B. Excuse me, where is the school?
   C. The rug is under the table.
   D. Go straight ahead.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into English: 'Salut, Kamau !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

22. Translate into English: 'Ce sont des oranges.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

23. Translate into English: 'Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

24. Translate into English: 'Il est grand.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

25. Translate into English: 'Le matin, je mange du pain.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

26. Translate into English: 'Voici un cadeau pour toi.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

27. Write in French: your birthday is on 25 December. (3 marks) (3 marks)

28. Translate into English: 'Mon anniversaire, c'est le 30 juin.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

29. Translate into English: 'Il neige.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

30. Translate into English: 'Demain, c'est jeudi.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

31. Translate into English: 'Le vendredi, je danse.' (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #8 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — on-shon-TAY
   Enchanté and enchantée are said the same: on-shon-TAY.

2. B — I am well, thank you.
   Ça va bien, merci. means I am well, thank you.

3. C — This is my mother.
   C'est ma mère. means This is my mother.

4. D — accent aigu
   The acute accent goes up from left to right.

5. B — Here is my grandfather.
   Voici mon grand-père. means Here is my grandfather.

6. A — le
   sac is masculine, so we say le sac.

7. B — two
   Deux chaises means two chairs.

8. A — jeudi
   The day after Wednesday is Thursday.

9. C — What day is it today?
   Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ? means What day is it today?

10. B — My birthday is on 30 June.
   Mon anniversaire, c'est le 30 juin. means My birthday is on 30 June.

11. D — 31
   Trente is 30 and un is 1.

12. D — It is a cake.
   C'est un gâteau. means It is a cake.

13. A — le
   jus is masculine, so we say le jus.

14. B — petite
   For a girl, we add e: petite.

15. B — le
   doigt is masculine, so we say le doigt.

16. C — He has short hair.
   Il a les cheveux courts. means He has short hair.

17. D — It is windy.
   Il y a du vent. means It is windy.

18. A — Today it is raining.
   Aujourd'hui, il pleut. means Today it is raining.

19. B — The door is next to the window.
   La porte est à côté de la fenêtre. means The door is next to the window.

20. D — Go straight ahead.
   Allez tout droit. means Go straight ahead.
